name: account_match
_comment: T207: both clients sign up on the dedicated server's TLS account endpoint (port + 1) the way the Account screen does, then join through the real menus signed in (session token in the auth handshake). The server ends the match at tick 240: accounts checks each account's result was applied on the server, sent back to the player (client profile = server's), and not written to the client's local profile.cfg.
